The frame extends above the highest labeled y tick, so only visible labeled y ticks were used as anchors.

x.visible_pattern: Bottom-axis tick labels 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120 are evenly spaced across the horizontal axis.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear model with normalized RMSE 0.0000 and rejected log10 because a zero tick is present.

y.visible_pattern: Left-axis tick labels 0.0 through 1.0 increase in uniform 0.2 steps and appear evenly spaced vertically within 1-pixel rounding.
y.justification: Axis-fit validation chose a linear model with normalized RMSE 0.0004; small residuals are consistent with integer-pixel rounding of visible tick centers. Log10 was rejected because a zero tick is present.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: Only the shared t=0 start point overlaps; the three decay curves are otherwise clearly separated across the main plot.

curves.overlap_notes: Shares the initial t=0 marker with the blue and red curves at the left border; otherwise visually distinct. Rightmost open marker is slightly border-clipped, so the final point is kept slightly inside the frame.

Shares the initial t=0 marker with the black and red curves at the left border; otherwise visually distinct. Final marker is slightly clipped by the right border and was centered conservatively inside the frame.

Shares the initial t=0 marker region with the black and blue curves at the left border; otherwise visually distinct. Triangle-marker points were re-centered on marker centroids, including the slightly clipped terminal marker.

response.interpretation_notes: Main plot only. Three monotonic decay traces are present: a black solid line with open circles (Blank), a blue dashed line with filled square markers (Catalyst A), and a red dash-dot line with filled triangle markers (Catalyst B). Legend glyphs in the upper-right were ignored. Left-border overlap and slightly clipped terminal markers were handled conservatively; the red triangle series was centered on marker centroids for the final trace.
unresolved_ambiguities: All three curves coincide at the initial t=0 point on the left border.
The terminal markers at the right border are slightly clipped, so the final point of each curve was placed slightly inside the frame.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
